Authentication

features/01-Authentication-Onboarding/flows/mmd/01-authentication.mmd
flowchart TD
  Start[Open TerriTool] --> Choice{Action}
  Choice -->|Login| Creds[Email + password]
  Creds --> Remember{Remember Me?}
  Remember --> Authn{Valid?}
  Authn -->|No| Err[Show error]
  Err --> Creds
  Authn -->|Yes| Active{Activated?}
  Active -->|No| Activate[Activation link]
  Active -->|Yes| App[Onboarding or Home]
  Choice -->|Forgot password| Reset[Email reset]
  Reset --> Creds
  Choice -->|Create Account| Trial[Name phone email password captcha]
  Trial --> Dup{Email unique + captcha OK?}
  Dup -->|No| Trial
  Dup -->|Yes| Grant[60 credits, 7-day trial]
  Grant --> Onb[Onboarding]
  Choice -->|QR / stores| Mobile[iOS or Android app]

Onboarding

features/01-Authentication-Onboarding/flows/mmd/02-onboarding.mmd
flowchart TD
  S1[Step 1: goals] --> Pick1{At least one goal?}
  Pick1 -->|No| S1
  Pick1 -->|Yes| Cont[Continue enabled]
  Cont --> S2[Step 2: role]
  S2 --> Back[Back to step 1]
  S2 --> Role{I'm in the field vs I lead a team}
  Role --> Sell{Businesses B2B vs Homeowners}
  Sell --> Ready{Role + sell-to picked?}
  Ready -->|No| S2
  Ready -->|Yes| Finish[Finish setup]
  Finish -->|Field| Home[Home]
  Finish -->|Manager| Mgr[Manager dashboard]

Company profile

features/03-Company-AddressBook/flows/mmd/07-company-profile.mmd
flowchart TD
  Open[Open company] --> See[Phone website hours status]
  See --> Act{Action}
  Act --> Route[Add to Route]
  Act --> List[Add to List]
  Act --> Edit[Edit fields / status]
  Act --> Report[Report issue]
  Report --> Reason{Wrong address / phone / site / closed / duplicate / other}
  Reason --> Submit[Submit report]
  Act --> FC[Find Contacts]
  FC --> Prov{FullEnrich or Claude}
  Prov -->|FullEnrich| FE[Buy: 2 credits each]
  Prov -->|Claude| CL[Buy: 1 credit each]
  FE --> Debit[Confirm then debit]
  CL --> Debit
  Debit -->|No credits| Pay[Buy credits]
  Act --> Manual[Create Contact]
  Act --> Activity[+ Add Activity]
  Activity --> Tabs[Today / Upcoming / Past]

AI Find Leads

features/05-Find-Leads/flows/mmd/03-ai-find-leads.mmd
flowchart TD
  Open[Open AI Find Leads] --> Mode{Search Multiple or Search One}
  Mode -->|Multiple| Loc[State + city]
  Loc --> Type[Business type text]
  Type --> AI[AI Ideal Prospects]
  AI --> Search[Search - free]
  Mode -->|One| Named[Named business lookup]
  Named --> Search
  Search --> Results{Leads found?}
  Results -->|No| Empty[Empty / refine]
  Empty --> Loc
  Results -->|Yes| Table[Table or Map View]
  Table --> Select[Check leads]
  Select --> Next[Next Step]
  Next --> Credits{Enough credits? 1 per lead}
  Credits -->|No| Pay[Upgrade or credits add-on]
  Credits -->|Yes| Save[Progress modal - keep tab open]
  Save --> Debit[Debit N credits]
  Debit --> Modal[Leads Added Successfully]
  Modal --> A1[Create or add Route]
  Modal --> A2[Create or add List]
  Modal --> A3[Return to Dashboard]
  Modal --> A4[Find More Leads]
  A1 --> RNew{New or existing route}
  RNew -->|New name| RBuild[Route builder step 1]
  RNew -->|Existing| RAppend[Append + optional re-optimize]
  A2 --> LNew{New or existing list}
  LNew -->|New name| LBuild[List builder]
  LNew -->|Existing| LAppend[Append companies]
  A4 --> Open

Create and publish a route

features/07-Routes/flows/mmd/04-create-publish-route.mmd
flowchart TD
  Entry{Entry} -->|From saved leads| Pre[Companies pre-selected]
  Entry -->|From list Convert/Generate| Pre
  Entry -->|+ Create Route| Empty[Pick companies]
  Pre --> Step1[Step 1: name + select]
  Empty --> Step1
  Step1 --> Opt{Action}
  Opt -->|Save as Draft| Draft[Routes Draft tab]
  Opt -->|Map / Lasso / Filter| Map1[Adjust selection]
  Map1 --> Step1
  Opt -->|Find Leads| LeadIn[AI search into this route]
  LeadIn --> Step1
  Opt -->|Next Step| Step2[Step 2: start + end]
  Step2 --> Opt2{Action}
  Opt2 -->|Save as Draft| Draft
  Opt2 -->|Generate Route| Gen[Optimize tour]
  Gen --> Success[Route Generated Successfully]
  Success --> View[View my Route]
  View --> Pub[Published tab]
  Pub --> Field[Download PDF / CSV / Send / Map / Mobile]

Upload Excel / CSV

features/10-Bulk-Upload/flows/mmd/12-upload-excel-csv.mmd
flowchart TD
  Dash[Home: Upload Excel/CSV] --> Kind{Companies or contacts}
  Kind --> S1[Step 1 upload file]
  S1 --> S2[Step 2 map columns / preview]
  S2 --> S3[Step 3 validate]
  S3 --> Err{Errors?}
  Err -->|Yes| Fix[Autofill address / merge / drop duplicates]
  Fix --> S3
  Err -->|No| S4[Step 4 commit]
  S4 --> SF{Push to Salesforce?}
  SF -->|Yes| Sfdc[step4sfdc]
  SF -->|No| Done[Companies/contacts in Address Book]

Billing

features/12-Subscription-Payments/flows/mmd/10-billing.mmd
flowchart TD
  Need{Need more access?} -->|Plan| Upgrade[Upgrade]
  Need -->|Credits only| Addon[Credits add-on]
  Need -->|Inspect| Hist[Subscription history]
  Upgrade --> Pay[Stripe / RevenueCat]
  Addon --> Pay
  Pay --> OK{Success?}
  OK -->|Yes| Active[Active subscription + credits]
  OK -->|No| Fail[Stay on current plan]
  Hist --> Cancel[Cancel with reason]
  Cancel --> End[Access until period end]
  Trial[7-day Free Package] --> Expire{End date passed?}
  Expire -->|Yes| BlockSave[Block save leads / buy contacts]
  BlockSave --> Upgrade

  Set --> Sub[View Invoice / Upgrade]

MCP agent lead-to-route

features/20-MCP/flows/mmd/14-mcp-agent-lead-to-route.mmd
flowchart TD
  Ask[User asks for leads] --> Cred[get_credits]
  Cred --> Search[find_ai_leads]
  Search --> More{Still running?}
  More -->|Yes| Resume[resume_ai_lead_search]
  Resume --> Search
  More -->|No| Preview[Preview hits - do not add_company]
  Preview --> Confirm{User agrees to spend?}
  Confirm -->|No| Stop[Stop]
  Confirm -->|Yes| Save[save_ai_leads confirm_all + token]
  Save --> Co[search_companies / view_company]
  Co --> Next{User wants route or list?}
  Next -->|List| AskL[Ask list name]
  AskL --> List[create_list]
  Next -->|Route| AskR[Ask start, end, route name]
  AskR --> Route[create_route - publishes]
  Route --> Url[Return route_url]
  List --> FromList[create_route_from_list]

MCP agent use cases

features/20-MCP/flows/mmd/uc-mcp-agent.mmd
flowchart TD
  Ask[User request] --> Credits[get_credits]
  Credits --> Find[find_ai_leads / resume]
  Find --> Preview[Preview hits<br/>never add_company]
  Preview --> Confirm{User confirms spend?}
  Confirm -->|No| Stop[Stop]
  Confirm -->|Yes| Save[save_ai_leads<br/>confirm_all + token]
  Save --> View[search_companies / view_company]
  View --> Want{Route or list?}
  Want -->|List| List[create_list]
  Want -->|Route| AskR[Ask start, end, name]
  AskR --> Route[create_route publishes]
  List --> FromList[create_route_from_list]
  Route --> Url[Return route_url]
  View --> Status[set_company_status]
  View --> People[find_contacts / add_contact]
  View --> Note[add_note / add_activity]
